what: It gives accounting, tax and compliance help, plus business and investor advice, to companies from small firms to listed ones.
proceeds: It expects about $19.2 million after costs. About 30% is for business development and marketing, 30% for growing local operations and setting up overseas branches, and 40% for general running costs and working capital.
risks: The company's results depend on keeping up demand for its services, and clients' needs change and are hard to predict.
A few customers bring in most of its income, so a customer failing to pay could hurt it.
Losing one or more of its largest customers could harm its business and results.
It has no long-term contracts with most clients, so it struggles to forecast demand and find staff in time.
It faces tough competition from firms with more money, and its services could become outdated or lose out on price.
